problem_statement.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from idea_brief_items.problem_statement — no drift.

target_users.summary: Independent UK producers/distributors without in-house compliance, and HORECA buyers wanting traceable, local ingredients with compliance evidence.
target_users.reasoning: Condensed from idea_brief_items.target_users (TU-01, TU-02) without dropping either.

value_proposition.summary: HarvestLink gives producers a compliance/traceability layer plus direct buyer discovery -- winning contracts without an in-house compliance team.
value_proposition.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from idea_brief_items.value_proposition — no drift.

market_context.summary: No competitor combines producer-friendly market access with compliance tooling -- the gap targeted; threat is a wholesaler bundling this first.
market_context.reasoning: Condenses market_analysis_items' SWOT into the single most decision-relevant insight.

constraint_summaries.mitigation_summary: Operate strictly as a data/matching and documentation layer; producers and distributors remain the FBOs, HarvestLink never takes physical possession of food.
Require producer and distributor dual sign-off on every traceability record, with an immutable audit log.
Require producer attestation and sign-off before any allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.

roadmap.title: Structure the platform as facilitation-only
roadmap.description_summary: Legal/product design validated with a design partner -- resolves Food-Business-Operator gap (CON-01); nothing later proceeds without this being right.

roadmap.title: Design and validate dual-sign-off traceability and allergen-declaration workflows
roadmap.description_summary: The Amber mitigations (CON-02, CON-03) must be built and tested with real producer/distributor data before onboarding opens beyond a pilot cohort.

roadmap.title: Pilot launch with capped cohort and completeness-scaled transaction limits
roadmap.description_summary: Then widen limits as completeness data accumulates.

open_risks.description_summary: Facilitation-only structuring risk: the roadmap depends on this structure; no fallback defined if it cannot fully avoid FBO status.
Compliance-documentation-completeness methodology: dual-sign-off and scoring is a design commitment, not a validated methodology yet.
Competitive response speed: a wholesaler could bundle a producer-marketplace feature into existing compliance infra before pilot launch.

executive_summary.summary: HarvestLink connects UK producers to foodservice buyers via compliance tooling no competitor offers; facilitation-only design is the top open risk.
executive_summary.reasoning: Every sentence condenses a claim already present elsewhere — no new claim introduced. Written last.
